status: new higher-harmonic constraint, no identified waveform replacement; no production edit

primary_sources.scope: Manufacturer SIN TBL names, printed p41; no numerical table widths.
Uploader original carrier-only experiment procedure, no modulation/feedback/frequency multiplication.
Yamaha FIG22 log-sine/shifter/log-linear/sign/gate architecture as historically plausible mechanism; no YM3420 attribution.

design.purpose: Audit signed squared sine higher partials and identify stereo-midpoint cancellation using exact retained waveform windows/frequencies. No new frequency/window/parameter search; no model fitting or promotion gate.
design.estimator: Twelve sine/cosine harmonic pairs plus DC, fixed prior fundamental, Hann-weighted ordinary least squares (weights apply to basis and signal). L/R/mid/side separately; full original window and three equal thirds. Absolute phases refer to first sample of each window; report amplitudes, relative dB, complex ratio/phase and fit residual.
design.native_probe: Actual shipping wave() in unchanged Engine.cpp via translation-unit include. One-second stationary carrier table1 at exact source frequency through engine with outputCircuit false/true, tone0, chorus0, drive0, limiterfalse, dcBlockfalse, clock0; analyze last350ms. Additional 65536-phase coherent direct wave1 identity/DC/PM algebra checks, no hardware equivalence claim.
design.math: Signed square sine odd-harmonic coefficients b_n=-8/(pi*n*(n*n-4)) for positive odd n; b_even=0; DC0. Reference higher harmonics never fitted from capture.
limits: Manual note gates, source effect/capture state and response unknown.
No exact-ROM, bit-depth, arithmetic-width, native-clock or DAC inference.
No production code edits; no audio rerender beyond two short native stationary controls.
No novel physical constants or artificial noise.

measurements.classification: Descriptive new harmonic/stereo observability audit only; no hardware-ROM/bit-depth/capture-transfer fit or production change.

post_observation_conditional_transfer.status: post-observation conditional-LTI diagnostic; no re-fit, no thresholds or adoption
post_observation_conditional_transfer.interpretation: A common capture/effect response could attenuate fifth partials in both tables. Differences across recorded passages prevent treating any inferred response as calibrated. Phase-invariant differences remove arbitrary note starting phase, but not time-varying capture effects.

validation.scope: Input hashes, four analyzed-window exact L/R identities, 48 retained full-window harmonic results, analytic Fourier coefficients by independent numerical integration, native wave/PM algebra, finite native control bindings. Not hardware bit accuracy.

failures_retained.cause: Verifier asserted entire-source L/R byte identity although the measurement only covered four fixed windows.
failures_retained.observed_scope: All four analyzed windows have exactly equal channel samples. Entire source has 1568 unequal samples outside them; first at 1.0535s, last at 60.847875s, maximum channel difference 0.00023423525.
failures_retained.correction: Assert exact L/R equality only for the four prospectively frozen analyzed windows. Do not claim whole-file mono.
failures_retained.effects: No audio, estimator, windows, results, candidate or protocol changed. No re-render or capture re-fit.

failures_retained.status: overprecise logarithmic comparison failed; retained original check
failures_retained.cause: Independent fit evaluates t*f*h rather than the original t*h*f. Fitted amplitude differences are 1.87e-16 to 6.38e-16, but relative dB of very quiet harmonics amplifies them to 3.18e-10dB, exceeding an unjustified 1e-10dB invariant.
failures_retained.correction: Compare all 48 linear fitted amplitudes with a 64 machine-epsilon bound scaled by the largest partial. The two numerical implementations are intentionally independent; no hardware gate changes.
failures_retained.effects: No measured or model source, frequency, window, coefficient, score or audio changed.

failures_retained.status: strict algebraic bit-identity check failed; retained
failures_retained.cause: Optimized compiled reference-expression subtraction is not guaranteed bit-identical to separately returned arithmetic, despite algebraic identity; compiler contraction is permitted. This is below one float64 machine epsilon at unit amplitude.
failures_retained.correction: Use one float64 machine epsilon for maximum unit-amplitude algebra/PM error; preserve actual observed errors and do not claim bit-exact hardware arithmetic.
failures_retained.effects: No compiler flag, compiled probe, source engine, native render or captured-data analysis changed.

failures_retained.status: TypeError before any analysis JSON written
failures_retained.cause: Implementation broadcasting defect: N-vector y multiplied by N-by-1 weights created N-by-N observations; coefficient serialization rejected vector entries.
failures_retained.correction: Use y*w, matching frozen Hann-weighted scalar least-squares protocol.
failures_retained.effects: No observations, model parameters, windows, frequencies or protocol changed. The already rendered two native controls were reused; no second audio render.

prohibited_inferences: No exact lookup coefficients, bit depths, phase widths, native synthesis update rate or DAC nonlinearity recovered.
Existing circuit not explaining missing fifth does not prove hardware ROM differs.
No capture filter fitted, no harmonic notch, no production candidate or new physical constants adopted.
Coherent unmodulated waveform DC and PM algebra do not establish internal chip modulator DC/gating behavior.
